A trans-red flare arcing up and over from the ops hut side, leaving a curling trail of white cloud-slope bricks dissolving above the windsock mast, one crewman shielding his printed face with both C-shaped hands.
Prop-wash flattening a broad fan of tuft elements behind the idling biplane tail and lifting a scatter of tan studs off the apron in a wide low arc toward the fence line.
A brick elephant ambling out onto the strip threshold, trunk raised high, while a crewman minifigure waves both yellow arms wildly from the verge, his cap plate tumbling free.
The wind cone snapping stiff and straight out on its mast as a gust crosses the strip, its orange-and-white banded fabric element rigid above a scatter of rolling fuel-drum round bricks below.
A shower of trans-pink blossom plates drifting across the grass from an orchard row beside the runway, settling across the upper wing of a taxiing biplane in a soft deep layer.
A kite on a long bar-and-clip line tangling itself in the strut rigging, the bright fabric element pinned flat against the cage while two kid minifigures haul desperately on the line below.
A striped brick hot-air balloon drifting low across the far end of the strip, its wicker-plate basket one stud above the hedgerow, a minifigure crewman leaning out over the rim with arms wide.
A stack of round-brick fuel drums toppling one after another across the apron, each rolling a different direction and leaving a zigzag trail of tan studs across the green plate mosaic.
A runaway produce cart bouncing down the strip edge with red apple studs scattering ahead of it, one wheel already off its axle pin and a chicken minifigure riding the flatbed tilting backward.

A flock of trans-pink brick flamingos lifting off a lagoon of trans-blue plates beside the strip, their trailing legs and flared wing plates arcing up across the runway threshold in a vivid pink wave.
A tarpaulin fabric element ballooning off a parked lower wing in the crosswind, straining against two clip anchors, while the mechanic minifigure below grabs for a corner with both C-shaped hands.

A trans-orange spark spitting bright from the exhaust stubs as the radial engine catches, a curling trail of white cloud-slope bricks streaming back along the fuselage flanks past a painted gold sunburst emblem.

A scatter of confetti studs in six colours still settling across the apron after the race finish, drifting into the open cowling of the nearest biplane while its pilot stands arms raised on the wing root.
A dog figure streaking flat out down the strip edge after the departing machine, ears back and all four legs extended, the mechanic behind him already laughing with one arm raised.
A brick bird-flock scattering up off the hangar ridge in a burst of dark-blue and orange plates, fanning wide across the strip just as the biplane lifts its wheels from the grass below.
A loose fabric panel peeling back along the lower wing root and rippling free in the slipstream, one clip already gone, the wing-walker minifigure above bracing both feet hard against a centre strut.
A spray of trans-blue plates thrown wide off the floats as the flying boat lifts free of the lagoon, the forward minifigure crewman gripping the nose strut with both hands as the gust hits.
White plate-flecks sheeting up behind a pair of brick skis as the ski-plane accelerates down a white-plate snowfield, a fur-hat minifigure in the open cockpit leaning forward into the spray.
A round hay-bale brick rolling loose across the threshold trailing a scatter of yellow straw studs, heading straight for the nose of a low taxiing biplane while its pilot waves one arm in alarm.

Trans-clear rain rods slanting hard across the field and beading in bright rows along the top wing, a mechanic minifigure hunched beneath an umbrella element holding the fuel hose steady with one hand.
A gust snatching a canvas tent flap up off its pegs beside the fuel point, the whole fabric element ballooning overhead and one corner wrapping around the windsock mast at the top.
A curling trail of white cloud-slope bricks streaming off a wingtip smoke pod as the biplane banks low over the strip, a ground crewman below shielding his eyes with both yellow hands.

A brass-band instrument tipping off its stand as the prop-wash reaches the verge, a brick tuba rolling away across the green plate mosaic while the startled tuba-player minifigure dives after it on both knees.

A plain pennant chain snapping taut along its bunting line between two poles as the slipstream hits, each plain triangular pennant plate standing rigid in a bright alternating row above the finish zone.

A brick sheep flock breaking away from the strip edge in a ragged line, a dozen white round-brick bodies scattering onto the green plate mosaic while the sheepdog minifigure sprints wide to head them off.
